query:
SELECT id, firstName, lastName, email, phone, status, membershipStatus, createdAt, organizationId
FROM students
WHERE LOWER(firstName) LIKE '%debbie%' AND LOWER(lastName) LIKE '%gregory%'
ORDER BY createdAt ASC;
